page.layout: One printed title page; all text centred in one column; a woodcut ornament and printer's device in the middle; no margin notes; library stamps (blue and red) overlap the text and are not transcribed.
page.notes: Blue oval library stamp and red circular stamp overlap the lines "Unà cum Notis, ac Figuris" and "Editio ultima, serìò castigata" and the title area; not transcribed. The woodcut ornament is an engraving-type decoration with no text. The "A" at the end of the publisher line is partly obscured by a red ink mark, and the final letters of "VANDER A" are uncertain. The date is printed as MDCXCV in the Roman numeral form. Some pen marks in the upper right corner are handwriting and omitted.
